description: Upload a local image file (png/jpeg/webp/gif/svg, ≤10 MB) as a session-scoped reference — the backend stores it immutably and the reference node points at its storage key. Use connectToNodeId to feed a generate node, then validate_asset_flow before running.

connectToNodeId.description: Generate node the reference should feed (edges it in when creating a new node).

filePath.description: Local image file (png/jpeg/webp/gif/svg) to attach as a generation reference. Read by this MCP process and uploaded to the session — keep it under 10 MB.

label.description: Short label for the reference node on the canvas.

nodeId.description: Reference node to create or update. Defaults to reference_<filename>; pass an existing reference node id to replace its image.

sessionId.description: Persisted flow session id (flow_session_…) from create_asset_flow or list_asset_flows.

name: add_flow_reference_image
